meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Expert data processing with a hybrid engine strategy: resident-kernel engines first - DuckDB plus a resident Python stack (Polars/numpy/matplotlib) in persistent js/py eval kernels where the harness has them, bun/uv one-shots elsewhere - and per-action placement judgment (in-memory vs streaming vs remote-in-place). Triggers: 'analyze the data', 'what is in this CSV/parquet/json', 'summarize this', 'group by', 'filter rows', 'sort by', 'join these files', 'merge datasets', 'time series trend', 'compare yesterday and today', 'distribution/histogram', 'correlation', 'clean duplicates', 'handle missing values', 'dataset larger than RAM', 'SQL query on files', 'DataFrame operations', 'chart/plot this data', DuckDB vs Polars selection, quick data exploration CLI. NOT for plain text/code inspection, configs, or tiny inline math.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,自动完成统计、聚合与可视化
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常处理CSV/JSON等数据文件并需要快速洞察
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files to produce statistics, aggregations, and charts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often process CSV/JSON files and need fast data insights

howto.what: 它会专门处理数据文件（CSV/Parquet/JSON）的查询、统计、绘图。先探测数据大小，再选内存、流式或远程计算，用 DuckDB/Polars 等引擎作答，并报行数与耗时。答完即止，不做多余图表。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析数据、查询或汇总 CSV/Parquet/JSON、画数据图时触发；分组、过滤等也会接管。不用于纯文本检查、配置或简单数学。

say.text: 分析这个 CSV：按部门统计平均薪资，并画柱状图。
say.note: 它会读取文件，用 DuckDB 聚合，然后画图并检查图表。

say.text: 这个 Parquet 有 10GB，内存不够，帮我算每月总销售额。
say.note: 它会选流式或磁盘溢出方式，避免内存占满。

say.text: 把这两个 JSON 按用户 ID 合并，并清理重复行。
say.note: 它会合并数据，并报告行数变化。

howto.what_en: Specializes in querying/summarizing/plotting data files (CSV/Parquet/JSON). Probes data size, picks in-memory vs streaming vs remote compute, uses DuckDB/Polars etc., reports row counts & timing. Stops after answering; no bonus charts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to analyze data, query or summarize CSV/Parquet/JSON files, or plot data; also takes over for operations like grouping or filtering. Not for plain-text inspection, configs, or simple math.

say_en.text: Analyze this CSV: average salary by department, then plot a bar chart.
say_en.note: Reads file, aggregates, plots, and verifies the chart.

say_en.text: This Parquet is 10GB, not enough RAM; compute monthly total sales.
say_en.note: Uses streaming or disk spill to avoid running out of memory.

say_en.text: Merge these two JSONs by user ID and clean duplicate rows.
say_en.note: Joins the data and reports row-count changes.
